source_snapshot.procedure: Queries device0/block0 then injects `amdgpuras -b 0 -s 4 -t 4 -m 1` without an explicit device selector after ras_enable setup.
source_snapshot.criteria: Requires injection success, amdgpu hardware-error logs and UMC count; examples mix BDF 38:00.0/0c:00.0, socket2 and one-versus-two total UCEs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes destructive injection but omits literal flags and target/count conflicts.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Adds safety gates while still leaving implicit injection targeting and inconsistent examples unresolved.

old_problem: The query selects device0 but injection omits `-d`; block/subblock/type/method semantics lack authority, examples name multiple BDFs and inconsistent totals, and the exact ACA/counter/recovery oracle is unresolved.
disposition_reason: GPU UUID/BDF can be a runtime binding only after the vendor proves the tuple and explicit target syntax. Here default targeting and destructive UCE semantics are core safety requirements. ED-04/12/15/16/19 prohibit guessing them or retrying, so execution is now explicitly BLOCKED.
decision_basis: Read row117/history2508 and kept its block0/subblock4/type4/method1 UMC parity coverage distinct from row116 listing and row118 GFX CE.
Preserved ras_enable setup, literal query/injection flags, single-shot wording and all example evidence conflicts.
Required stable UUID/BDF/device-index binding and an exact target-specific baseline-to-delta oracle.
Required raw ACA fields, containment and GPU/host recovery after the one destructive event.
No driver reload, default-target inference, injection, clear, reset/reboot, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD GPU UMC address/command parity UCE one-shot injection
test_case.purpose: On one explicitly approved UUID/BDF, inject exactly one vendor-proven UMC address/command parity UCE, correlate target-specific ACA/UMC evidence and the approved counter delta, then recover GPU and host without repeating the event.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras build/version/checksum and definitions for block0/subblock4/type4/method1
Explicit UUID/BDF/model/device-index map and target-selection syntax
Resolution of query `-d 0` versus injection without `-d` and sample BDF/socket/count conflicts
Approved ras_enable activation without unplanned multi-GPU driver disruption
Expected ACA STATUS/ADDR/MISC/IPID/SYND, counter delta, containment/deadlines and recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the implicit-target source command. After owner approval, bind one UUID/BDF to the reviewed tuple, capture raw UMC counters/log cursor/idle/ras_enable baseline, run the exact explicit-target equivalent once, preserve the first transcript and target evidence, then follow the approved recovery with no retry.
test_case.expected_result: Only the authorized GPU records the signed UMC AC-parity UCE and exact approved counter increment, fresh ACA fields identify its BDF/socket/die, containment matches policy, and post-recovery GPU topology, firmware/driver, memory and representative workload are healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until tuple semantics, explicit target and example reconciliation are authoritative. A success string or preexisting nonzero total is insufficient; wrong BDF, ambiguous delta, missing ACA fields, unrelated GPU event, reset/hang/poison or incomplete recovery fails/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle non-production accelerator with independent console/OOB and approved GPU/host recovery.
No amdgpu unload/reload for ras_enable without multi-GPU owner authorization.
One explicit UUID/BDF target and one injection once.
Abort/escalate on mapping drift, unexpected BDF, poison, reset, hang or evidence loss; never retry.
expected_evidence: Tool provenance and authoritative tuple/target semantics
UUID/BDF/model/index, driver/firmware/kernel/OS, ras_enable and idle baseline
Target UMC UCE counter baseline and timestamped log cursor
Fresh matching BDF/socket/die ACA raw fields and approved counter delta
Containment/recovery, post-topology/workload health, restoration diff and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Preserve first-failure evidence and use only the owner-approved GPU/host OOB recovery. Restore tool/debug/driver state without clearing needed records, verify every GPU identity/topology and the target's memory/workload health. Do not automatically repeat the UCE.

source_conflict.reason: Query-versus-injection targeting, two sample BDFs and one-versus-two totals remain internally inconsistent.

blocked.reason: An implicit-target uncorrectable UMC injection can hit the wrong GPU, propagate poison, reset/wedge the accelerator or require host recovery.
